prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide teaching photograph for a premium navy, warm ivory and muted gold learning app for a 12-year-old. Primary request: a two-panel comparison with the SAME 12-year-old boy with medium brown skin, short curly hair, plain navy sweatshirt, SAME cream desk, SAME silver laptop and SAME navy over-ear WIRED headphones. Left panel: he listens with a puzzled expression and holds one plain BLACK detachable audio cable near the laptop. Right panel: he listens with a relaxed pleased expression, a plain GOLD detachable audio cable visibly connecting the SAME headphones to the SAME laptop. Show distinct cables as the one change, not different headphones, not a different computer. Natural faces, hands and believable home desk scene, bright window light, sharp recognizable objects, realistic textures. Horizontal diptych separated by a thin ivory gutter, equal framing and sizes, generous uncluttered composition. No written labels, no letters, no diagrams, no sound waves, no floating icons, no brand logos, no robots, no decorative mascots. This is an illustration of an invented comparison; do not draw data or precise results.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: wide museum-quality illustrated reconstruction for a premium Grade 6 lesson about written laws in the Roman Republic. Primary request: a small gathering of ordinary Roman citizens near publicly displayed law tablets in a modest fifth-century-BCE Roman public square, one adult citizen pointing at the posted tablets and another reading the rules aloud to nearby people listening thoughtfully. Show recognizable human faces, hands, simple wool tunics, sandals, ochre plaster and stone, warm sunlight; a woman in the surrounding market is visible without implying she is voting. Grounded painterly realism, sophisticated educational editorial art with tactile detail, suited to age 12. Muted navy cloth, warm ivory stone and amber-gold light. Landscape 3:2 framing. Tablets are the focus with small indistinct inscriptions, no readable invented Latin, no English labels. This is clearly an artistic reconstruction, not a photograph or exact surviving artifact. No Colosseum, imperial crowns, legion battle scene, generic cartoon people, robots, circles standing in for humans, modern objects or glowing fantasy effects.
